details:
Now this might sound similar and i don't entirely know if this was suggested. But i have been wanting to request this for quite some time. As of right now, the VRChat World Favorites functions to where you add it to four categories, worlds1-4, and only up to 100. Allowing for a total of 100 worlds to be saved. Now, this is great and all but in my case, i utilize favorites to order and structure a entire Roleplay Group.

Here's what i got. Keep in mind i used a image editor to try and show my vision. Now anyhow, What i thought was, while the current system is nice and all. Why don't we have subfolders? A button that could allow us to sort worlds into subfolders that we can label? So certain worlds can be sorted in a more organized fashion, rather then using spreadsheets or notes. 

I find this issue in terms of my Roleplay Group. We have a vast world and many locations, it's impossible to keep everything sorted. I had to favorite worlds in an order so that people can open discord and check a channel that lists the worlds in the exact order as in VR. This was all so that they could know what world went to what location. I feel that subfolders would eliminate this issue entirely. Although i do feel that a stepping stone would be finding a better method to where favorited worlds are stored to allow for a larger list of favorites. 

The pictures below try to showcase what i mean. The main screen holding the main playlists and any worlds that aren't sorted into said playlists. If you click on lets say: "LocationA", then the second screen would show up with an option to make a subfolder within a subfolder. Now to mitigate abuse, while you can make subfolders within subfolders, you can only go to a max of two from the original root.

`> Worlds 4`

..-> 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗔 𝘀𝘂𝗯𝗳𝗼𝗹𝗱𝗲𝗿

.....⤷LocA DayVars

........- ⤷ LocA Extras (MAX) 

..-> 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗕 𝘀𝘂𝗯𝗳𝗼𝗹𝗱𝗲𝗿

.....⤷LocB NightVars

.......- ⤷ LocB Extras (MAX) 

..->LocationC subfolder

   (etc)

I know it's most likely never going to happen, but hey! thought i should still slide this over anyways!
title: A Cleaner and more effective World Favorites system
